SELECT m.id, m.name, m.original_name, m.url, m.type, m.size, m.extension, m.upload_user_id, u.nickname AS upload_user_nickname, m.create_time FROM cms_media m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.upload_user_id
AND m.type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{type}, '%')
AND (m.original_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY m.id DESC
